extracted.intended_audience: public information officers, emergency managers, and government communicators seeking PIO training
extracted.subtask_description: Overview and curriculum-level guidance for training Public Information Officers (PIOs) to plan and execute public information and strategic communications before, during, and after disasters.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Right Message, to the Right People, at the Right Time
rubrics_metrics.description: The NDEMU PIO training program is designed to provide PIOs with the essential knowledge, skills, and abilities to support proper decision-making by delivering the right message, to the right people, at the right time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program emphasis: ensure communications enable proper decision-making. This phrase is the program's core standard for effective public information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public information as a vital disaster function
rubrics_metrics.description: Public information is a vital function in disaster operations that contributes greatly to saving lives and protecting property.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public information entails the processes and systems that enable effective communications with various target audiences; treat public information as integral to life-safety and property-protection missions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PIO core tasks: gather, verify, coordinate, disseminate
rubrics_metrics.description: PIOs must perform the tasks of gathering, verifying, coordinating, and disseminating public information at all levels of government.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training provides opportunity to learn and practice these tasks; emphasis on accuracy (verify), interagency coordination, and timely dissemination.

rubrics_metrics.name: 95/5 Concept (non-emergency vs emergency activities)
rubrics_metrics.description: The 95/5 concept correlates to the non-emergency and emergency ratio of PIO activities: about 95% of work occurs in non-emergency times while about 5% is directly related to incident response or recovery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The activities performed during non-emergency posture have a significant impact on success during the emergency 5%; training focuses on both non-emergency preparedness and emergency response skills.

rubrics_metrics.name: Whole community strategic communications planning
rubrics_metrics.description: Courses thematically focus on the 95/5 concept and whole community strategic communications planning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure PIOs can implement communications strategies that reach the whole community so the right message reaches the right people at the right time; planning should consider diverse audiences and community partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Information Awareness and Basics
rubrics_metrics.description: Underlying concepts, and the basic skills needed for full or part time PIOs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Introductory-level standard: covers foundational knowledge and basic practical skills appropriate for new or part-time PIOs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic PIO
rubrics_metrics.description: A course level in the PIO progression focused on core PIO capabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Represents expected competency for routine PIO duties during non-emergency operations and basic incident support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advanced Public Information Officer
rubrics_metrics.description: Advanced-level PIO training to build higher-level capabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on more complex incident communications, coordination, and applying advanced techniques in operational contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply Advanced Public Information Skills in a Multi-Day Functional Exercise
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical application of advanced PIO skills in a multi-day functional exercise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Performance standard: demonstrate ability to apply advanced skills under simulated operational conditions; experiential assessment through exercise participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive Public Information Officer Program
rubrics_metrics.description: Expanded role in delivering strategic public information and warning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Executive-level competency: strategic oversight, leadership in public information and warning, and expanded responsibilities in whole-community communications planning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progressive course series culminating in a master PIO course
rubrics_metrics.description: The PIO program series moves progressively through public information awareness & basics to advanced PIO concepts, and culminates in a master public information officer course series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training pathway expectation: build from awareness to mastery; curriculum structured to develop increasing levels of skill, judgment, and leadership in PIO roles.
